verdict.rationale: Event-triggered rule systems are a fair axis for 3D engines, since an engine could ship trigger-and-action behaviors, so this is not a category error. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents three.js letting users define rules that fire actions automatically on events. The pack covers only renderers, TSL, loaders, controls, the editor and llms.txt, none of which is an event-rule automation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
